customManagers.description: Git-hosted Helm charts pinned to semantic version tags
matchStrings: $[repoURL and srcChart and srcTargetRevision and $contains(srcTargetRevision, /^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/)].($repo := $match(repoURL, /^(https?:\/\/[^/\s]+)\/(\S+)\.git$/); $repo ? {"registryUrl": $repo.groups[0], "depName": $repo.groups[1], "currentValue": srcTargetRevision})

$[repoURL and srcChart and srcTargetRevision].($repo := $match(repoURL, /^oci:\/\/([^/\s]+)\/(\S+)$/); $repo ? {"registryUrl": 'https://' & $repo.groups[0], "depName": srcChart, "packageName": $repo.groups[1] & '/' & srcChart, "currentValue": srcTargetRevision})

$[repoURL and srcChart and srcTargetRevision and $contains(repoURL, /^https?:\/\//) and $not($contains(repoURL, /\.git$/))].{"registryUrl": repoURL, "depName": srcChart, "currentValue": srcTargetRevision}
